about: How a house rule is named, in every namespace and both languages: <category>-<verb>-<object> after the namespace, with the category and the verb from these closed lists. Ported rules keep their upstream names and are not judged here. Adding a category or a verb is a decision about the scheme, so it is made here, once, and both engines read it.
